title: 1708 Prairie built from the Glessner townhouse photographs
items: 1708 Prairie Avenue, next door to the Glessner townhouses, is no longer a draft box. It is now a three-storey brick front under a deep plain cornice, with a stone string course under the frieze, hooded windows, a canted bay rising two storeys on the south, and the entrance at the north end under a bracketed hood.

Two photographs of the townhouses show 1708 at their edge, and both are now on the house's card. Their cameras are solved against the townhouses' front, and the house is built to match what they show. The plan behind the front, a long brick range and a narrow wing toward the alley, comes from the 1911 Sanborn map.
